easy.q: How many movies are in the Kung Fu Panda series, through 2024's Kung Fu Panda 4?
easy.fact: Jack Black has voiced Po in every one.

easy.q: Since a 1941 law, U.S. Thanksgiving falls on which-numbered Thursday of November?
easy.fact: Before that, presidents picked the date each year.

easy.q: How many wishes does the Genie grant in Disney's Aladdin?
easy.fact: Robin Williams voiced the Genie in the 1992 film.

easy.q: At the equator, about how many hours of daylight are there each day?
easy.fact: It stays nearly the same all year long.

easy.q: On a standard outdoor running track, about how many laps make a mile?
easy.fact: Four laps fall about 10 yards short of a full mile.

medium.q: In what year did HBO's The Last of Us premiere?
medium.fact: It's based on the 2013 PlayStation game.

medium.q: How many personal fouls does it take to foul out of an NBA game?
medium.fact: In college basketball, players foul out after five.

medium.q: To the nearest mile, how wide is the Strait of Gibraltar at its narrowest point?
medium.fact: On clear days you can see Morocco from Spain across it.

medium.q: The Great Fire of London in 1666 burned for how many days?
medium.fact: It started in a bakery on Pudding Lane.

medium.q: To the nearest minute, how long is Queen's song Bohemian Rhapsody?

hard.q: Don Shula holds the record for NFL coaching wins. How many did he win, counting the playoffs?
hard.fact: His 1972 Dolphins are still the NFL's only perfect team.

hard.q: How tall is Colorado's Pikes Peak, in feet?
hard.fact: The view from its summit inspired the song America the Beautiful.

hard.q: In 1919, Alcock and Brown made the first nonstop flight across the Atlantic. To the nearest hour, how long did it take?
hard.fact: They landed nose-first in an Irish bog.

hard.q: How many years after its 1994 release did Mariah Carey's All I Want for Christmas Is You first hit No. 1 on the Hot 100?
hard.fact: It finally reached No. 1 in December 2019.
